The failing test `testIterateJDOM()` in class `org.apache.commons.jxpath.ri.model.AliasedNamespaceIterationTest` is related to the method `iteratePointers(String xpath)` in class `org.apache.commons.jxpath.ri.JXPathContextReferenceImpl` in the Apache Commons JXPath library.

From the current bug report, it seems that the `JXPathContext.iteratePointers()` method is not working correctly when there are multiple prefixes for a single namespace URI. Specifically, when iterating over elements with the same namespace but different prefixes, the first element is returned multiple times, and the second element is not returned.

Looking at the code snippet of the `iteratePointers(String xpath)` method, it seems to compile the XPath expression using `compileExpression(String xpath)` method before iterating. This compilation process may be related to how the prefixes are handled in the XPath expressions.

I suggest investigating how the XPath expressions with multiple prefixes for the same namespace are compiled and handled in the `compileExpression(String xpath)` method. There might be an issue with how namespace prefixes are resolved or mapped during the compilation process, leading to incorrect iteration behavior when multiple prefixes are present for the same namespace URI.

Further analysis of the XPath expression compilation and namespace handling logic in the `compileExpression(String xpath)` method could help uncover the root cause of the incorrect iteration behavior observed in the failing test.

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
